name: Damage block swap
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: de-don
description: Every time you take damage, two random block types swap places. Stone becomes sand, water becomes lava, oak logs become glass — and the rules keep stacking up. Survive long enough and your familiar world twists into something gloriously unrecognizable
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln 0.4.9 (119 classes, 219 members). Not run yet.
